text:
maria.w: Quick proposal — add a 'micro-savings rollup' column to the cost dashboard that shows amortized cache savings and routing gains per session. Idea: instead of lumping all cache credits at model-level, show a per-session/unit view so PMs and SREs can see small wins from prefix caching and smarter routing. Thoughts?

dan: I like the intent. Is this just a rename of cache-crediting or a different metric? main diff seems granularity and attributing fractional savings to sessions, right? We must avoid double-counting when requests fall back between models.

maria.w: Exactly — session-scoped. We amortize KV/prefix hits across tokens in that session. e.g., a cached prefix reduces token cost for subsequent calls; attribute fractional saving to the originating route/customer.

oliver: Two constraints: 1) telemetry volume — per-session token-breakdown will balloon our metrics stream. 2) billing & quotas separation — customers expect quota to be simple (tokens consumed) not adjusted by rolled-up savings.

sophie: On telemetry we can sample+extrapolate. We already sample traces in net-unit-econ. Proposal: 1% sample for micro-savings with CI bands. UX: show "estimated micro-savings" with a small confidence indicator and a toggle to include/exclude estimates.

ryan: Routing-wise we'll need pre-routing choice + final model + cache hit info. That implies adding a tiny optional field to the internal request events. Suggest opt-in header: `X-RW-CACHE-HIT: none|prefix|kv` and a telemetry flag `rw_track_session_cost=true`. Minimal surface area change.

maria.w: Proposed protobuf pseudocode for telemetry: 
```
message SessionCostEvent {
  string route = 1;
  string model = 2;
  int64 tokens_total = 3;
  int64 tokens_charged = 4; // tokens after cache deduction
  bool kv_prefix_hit = 5;
  float estimated_savings_usd = 6;
}
```
This stays optional so ingestion is backward-compatible.

dan: We can't add mandatory fields to the UDP pipeline. Optional is fine. Important: aggregator must dedupe sessions across retries and map retry IDs to original session id.

cost-bot: :rotating_light: Cost alert: sample rule triggered — sessions with >30% KV savings reported: 142 in last 24h.

sophie: UX notes: dashboard small sparkline "micro-savings" per route; hover shows sample count + CI. Table add column "est. per-session savings" with tooltip: "Weighted by sampled sessions; excludes cross-route cache sharing." Also add a switch to make values billing-neutral (estimates only) so finance isn't confused.

oliver: Rollout plan: feature-flag telemetry capture + dashboard column. Start internal-only, then opt-in tenant cohort (beta). Also ensure we never auto-modify quotas based on estimate — show as advisory. Finance signoff required before any billing-facing display.

ryan: Implementation rough timeline: 
- API: opt-in header + telemetry flag (wk1)
- Ingest: accept optional fields + schema evolve (wk2)
- Aggregation: sampled extrapolation job + dedupe (wk3)
- Dashboard: panel + toggle (wk4)
Will prepare PRs per step.

maria.w: +1 on sample+flag approach. I'll draft a short RFC and a QA dataset. Thanks all. :thumbsup:

dan: tagging @sophie for mocks. @ryan can you add the header to the internal client?

sophie: on it, will push mocks by EOD.

maria.w: Saving notes to the RFC repo, moving discussion there. Closing thread for now."
